item.title: Mythic C2 : Evading Advanced Detection Systems (Part 1)
item.description: This is the continuation of this article Advanced Detection Systems are a real headache for red teamers (as they should be). Modern environments aren’t just relying on static AV anymore, you’re dealing with layered detection: AV, EDR, SIEM correlation, sometimes even behavioral ML on top. So instead of trying to “bypass everything” (which is unrealistic), the idea here is to reduce your footprint at each layer. In this part, I focused on a few steps that already make a big difference in a real-world engagement.
